about: Topology's four-pillar taxonomy, as data. Read by Topology::Taxonomy (Perl) and www/js/topology-core.js. The prose reading is design/TAXONOMY.org. Every word the app shows a person resolves to one row here or is reported as a gap (perl/Topology/t/40-taxonomy.t).

pillars.name: Place
pillars.holds: hosts, sites, racks, rooms, folders, repositories as places, URLs, mirrors

pillars.name: Part
pillars.asks: What is it, and what is it made of?
pillars.holds: components, packages, modules, versions, containment, the kind of a thing

pillars.name: Path
pillars.asks: How does it connect, flow or happen?
pillars.holds: links, transports, processes (BPMN and BPMN+), flowcharts, logic, data and control flow

pillars.name: Person
pillars.asks: Who may see it, change it, or answer for it?
pillars.holds: people and roles, consent, privacy, credentials, sharing, attribution, the act of saying go

axes.name: Layer
axes.asks: At what level is this drawn?

values.says: an idea or a design; nothing need exist
how it runs: processes, services, schedules
what you could touch or ping: boxes, cables, disks
shapes or words describe something buildable
over an existing thing, the drawing is a proposed change, or asks for a prompt to make it
press go, and tools that can make the change make it

tensions.name: where it sits / how it moves
tensions.says: a host is a place, its link a path; a mirror is both. Draw it once and show both readings rather than choosing.

tensions.name: what it is / who answers for it
tensions.says: a package is a part; its maintainer, its licence and who may push are person. Keep them on separate rows that link.

tensions.name: where it is / who may see that
tensions.says: a location can itself be private; show-private applies to places too.

tensions.name: what it is / what it does
tensions.says: a service is a part when packaged and a path when running; the layer axis tells which reading is drawn.

tensions.name: the box / what is in the box
tensions.says: containment: a repository is a place you can clone and a part you can package.

tensions.name: the flow / the hand on it
tensions.says: a BPMN lane is a person; a task in it is a path. Go is a path step that only a person may take.

words.sense: anything the drawing can hold other things in; may carry a TOPOLOGY.md
a git repository named in repos.d; also a part when packaged
a machine with a name, such as gw26
a second place holding the same parts
a thing inside a container that is described on its own
a Debian package or a CPAN distribution
one switchable thing the server does; see etc/topology.conf
a line between two shapes; it may name a medium
an ordered set of steps, drawn in a notation (BPMN, BPMN+, flowchart)
a set of rules for what shapes mean; chosen by the person
the act of letting tools effect a proposed change
the part of a TOPOLOGY.md under a Private heading
a key, token or password file named (never held) in repos.d
a person's yes, given at the step where it applies (the upgrade wizard's ACCEPT)
how the app looks and moves for this person (classic, console, cards ...)
a Topology API the browser may talk to: none, your own, ours, or any
a way of using the app where every setting and drawing stays in this browser
